problems.question: Write 70% as a fraction in lowest terms.
problems.solution: 70% = 70/100. Divide top and bottom by 10 (cross out a zero in each): 7/10.

problems.question: Write 9/10 as a decimal.
problems.solution: Nine tenths means a 9 in the tenths place: 0.9.

problems.question: Write 65% as a decimal.
problems.solution: Move the decimal point two places left: 65. becomes 0.65.

problems.question: Write 0.37 as a percent.
problems.solution: Move the decimal point two places right: 0.37 becomes 37%.

problems.question: Write 80% as a fraction in lowest terms.
problems.solution: 80% = 80/100. Divide by 10 to get 8/10. Divide by 2 to get 4/5.

problems.question: Write 7% as a decimal.
problems.solution: 7. moves two places left. Add a zero since there are no more digits: 0.07.

problems.question: A sales tax rate is 3.5%. Write it as a decimal.
problems.solution: Move the decimal point twice left, adding a zero as needed: 3.5 becomes 0.035.

problems.question: Write 0.07 as a percent.
problems.solution: Move the decimal point two places right: 0.07 becomes 7%.

problems.question: Write 2/5 as a percent. (Hint: first find 1/5 as a decimal.)
problems.solution: 1/5 = 0.2, so 2/5 = 0.4. Move the decimal two places right: 40%.

problems.skill: decimal with fraction part to percent
problems.question: Write 0.125 as a percent.
problems.solution: Move the decimal point two places right: 0.125 becomes 12.5%.
